prompt: For each signup month from April to June 2025, how many users reached each step of the signup funnel: signed up, activated, paid? A user counts as activated with a first_campaign_sent event, and as paid with at least one payment, refunded or not; a user counts at a step only when the user also reached the step before, at any time. signup_ts is a UTC instant, read in UTC. Return four columns, in this order: signup_month (the first day of the month), signed_up, activated and paid, each a number of users. Return one row for each signup month. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the three step counts: every user who signed up, the activated users, and the paid users who were also activated.
Count rows of the joined lists, not events; a paying user counts in the paid column only when the user's activation row is there too.
faded_shape:
WITH act AS (  -- one row per activated user
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM activation_events
  WHERE event_name = 'first_campaign_sent'
),
pay AS (  -- one row per user who has paid
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id
  FROM subscriptions s
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS signup_month,
why_this_works: The outer joins keep every user who signed up, and the paid count needs the activation row, so a payer who was never activated drops out.
faded_suffix:
FROM signups u
LEFT JOIN act a ON a.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-04-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY signup_month
